sentences.l2: 公司用很多数据教软件。
sentences.l1: The company uses a lot of data to teach the software.
The data must be clean, not messy.

sentences.l2: 人要知道数据从哪里来。
sentences.l1: People must know where the data comes from.

sentences.l2: 公司要说清楚软件怎么学。
sentences.l1: The company must explain clearly how the software learns.
When people use the software, it must be safe.
The company checks the data every week.
The boss must read the report.

sentences.l2: 这样，大家才相信这个软件。
sentences.l1: Only in this way will everyone trust this software.
When the software has problems, they must be fixed right away.
After it is fixed, users must be told.
